Allocates an uninitialised array of n 32-byte elements and returns the block.

Algorithm:
 Rejects counts above 0x800000000000000, multiplies by 0x20, calls New and returns the block (0 for n=0). Above 0xfff it allocates size+0x27 and returns the 0x20-aligned pointer with the raw allocation at -8.

Parameters:
 param_1 - unused; param_2 - element count.

Returns:
 Pointer to the allocated block, or 0 when n==0.

Inserts one 0x10-byte value into a vector of 16-byte elements, growing capacity to max(1.5*capacity, size+1).

Algorithm:
 Size/capacity come from >>4; the new block is New(capacity*0x10) (over-aligned above 0xfff). The 16-byte value at param_3 is written after shifting the prefix and before shifting the suffix; the old buffer is freed and begin/end/capacity are rewritten.

Parameters:
 param_1 - vector {begin,end,capacity}; param_2 - insertion position; param_3 - new element (two qwords).

Returns:
 Pointer to the inserted element.

Scales a render mesh's vertices and reverses their winding when the scale signs differ.

Algorithm:
    Multiplies the X/Y of every vertex in the mesh at this+0x1b8 by scaleX/scaleY; when the product of the two scales is negative it also reverses the vertex order so the winding stays consistent. Multiplies the two floats at this+0x920/+0x924 (Body scaleX/scaleY) by the same factors, then calls vtable slots +0x1f8/+0x98/+0x90. When recurse is non-zero it walks the +0x100 part list, rescales each Body's +0x128/+0x12c pair and recurses with 1.

Parameters:
    body - Body owning the mesh and the part list.
    scaleX - X scale factor.
    scaleY - Y scale factor.
    recurse - non-zero propagates the scale to the child bodies; every observed call site passes 1.

Returns:
    void.

Creature_BurnFuel (was rep_140075c70_Get_Profile_?; 1.151 label, wrong). Entry is 0x14007a220 (not 0x14007a210, which is the previous function's end).
Signature (ship, double amount, char flag) -> double burned.
IN-BATTLE FUEL BURN. Static read 2026-10-17, not yet tested in game.
- amount==0 -> return 0.
- Fast path: if DAT_147fc6fb6==0 and ship+0xc80 is negative (f64 < 0): take min(amount, ship+0x1638) straight off ship fuel, no tank parts touched.
- Normal path: iterate ship parts list (ship+0x1378..+0x1380, stride 0x18, part ptr at +8). For each part with f64 tank fuel at part+0x7f8 != 0 (and, when flag==0, only parts with float part+0x80c != 0), take amount * (part fuel / ship fuel), clamped to part fuel; subtract from part+0x7f8.
- ship+0x1638 (f64) = current fuel, ship+0x1640 (f64) = capacity. Burned total is subtracted from +0x1638 and added to ship+0x17f8 (float, fuel burned total).
- If FUN_140293920(Get_Profile_(), ship) is true (player's ship): radio call via rep_1402a2f40_New(code) when fuel/capacity crosses down through 0.5/0.3/0.2/0.1 -> codes 0xe/0xd/0xc/0xb = radio_fuel_50/30/20/10 (see PlayRadioSounds_ at 0x1402d5910).
Callers of the fuel state: aiShipDriver 0x140073a5e (empty -> flag), tacticalCombat 0x1402ffa07 (FUEL_TADS blink), spawn 0x140267699 (+0xbd0 start fuel).

Selects the best enemy ship for an aircraft group to attack, or reports the current target.

Algorithm:
    If the group already has a target (+0x5c) it looks for a matching ship in the group list and returns it. Otherwise it scores every enemy ship in the group radius by side (+0x178), the 0x147/0x800000001047 body flags, distance to the group and to the player, and the range limit (+0x24c + 50), returning the first ship that passes the range and separation checks.

Parameters:
    param_1 - aircraft group

Returns:
    the selected target ship (Node) or null.

    - Refreshes the part's current facing pair at +0x210 through vtable +0xe8; the saved
      angle is +0x138.
    - Removes the four engine codes 0x64/0x65/0x66/0x67 from the part's pending-command

      otherwise they are swapped.

      way, it first mirrors the engine mesh with RenderMesh_ScaleAndFlip(part,-1,1,1) and
      queues {0x64,0x66} or {0x65,0x67} instead.

    hf_notes/docs/findings/ai/ai-steering-and-avoidance.md s5: 100 (bank 1 angle),
    0x65 (bank 2 angle), 0x66 (bank 1 angle + strength), 0x67 (bank 2 angle + strength).
